binding: Complete four raw alias bridges precede content; alias-only query is mapped through observed bridges; late delay20or100 and long distractor stream; supplied symbolic mapping, not semantic or real AV learning
bounded_uncertainty_gate: Calibration gatepassed; all1024main worlds valid with positive true-label support; >=32fractional accepted answers; one-sided95%generator-bootstrap upper fractional error<=.10
confirmation_inference: 4096 paired generator-cluster bootstrap replicates, seed1888113; resample all256generators including zero-answer clusters, retain all4dependentworlds. A zero accepted denominator in a bootstrap replicate gives upper risk1. Intervals are bootstrap evidence, not exact finite-sample coverage guarantees
fractional: Predicted maximum probability strictly below 1-1e-9; near-point-masses are not called mathematical certainty
invalid_rule: Any unexpected model invalidity makes whole-population quality null; unsupported-vocabulary panel refusal retained separately. All attempts/costs remain in raw records
mask: 2,3or4 uniform prelude positions independent of event content; erased raw events reveal no kind, key, value
new_generator_scope: Independent continuous parameter draws from the same declared population, not arbitrary new families; separate rotor and vocabulary panels probe misspecification
ood_gate: Model-specific .99 higher empirical quantile of per-observed-WRITE prefix conditional value surprise from128separate generators; strict unsupported raw schemas fail closed; no universal OOD detection guarantee
ordinary_model_comparison_gate: Same-initial-public-prefix BEFORE-READ Markov-vs-poolediid Brier improvement mean>=.01 and paired two-sided95%generator-bootstrap lowerbound>0; actual selective payoff lowerbound>=0. After-READ score uses policy-dependent purchased information and is reported separately; no analytic HCSN core D-B or production adoption
parameter_population: Each independent generator draws pi~Dirichlet(.7,.7,.7,.7), rho=0 with probability1/2 else Uniform(.55,.95), overwrite key mixture q~Uniform(0,1)
pre_holdout: Publish immutable sources before training/calibration. Then publish fitted models, OOD and risk thresholds and POSTCALIBRATION_FREEZE before new-generator confirmation
read: At most one actual indexed missing token; joint posterior conditions at its original position; prices .02,.12,.3,.6 independent of content
reliability_scope: Maintain original90%reliability target; this new finite task does not replace any original HCSN gate. Failure or abstention remains a negative result; no .25risk substitution
risk_selection: One query/world per independent calibration generator. For each fixed model/threshold compute exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson accepted-error and fractional-accepted-error bounds at delta=.05/(2models*4thresholds*2risks). Require both upperbounds<=.10 and>=20fractional answers. Among passing thresholds select maximum fractional count then lowest threshold. None=>near-pointmass-only fallback and gatefailed; no postholdout threshold repair
schedule: Six chronologically ordered WRITEs: initial key permutation then two keys from q*uniform-distinct+(1-q)*uniform-independent; random interleaving with8or24distractors
training_information: Only complete raw public training token streams and generator group membership; no generator parameters, owner targets or masked events enter model fitting
utility: Answer correct+1, incorrect-1, abstain0, subtract READ fee; candidate READ maximizes model expected selective payoff at each fixed threshold
